issue_context.title: When panic occurred in disttask framework scheduling process, disttask framework will not serve anymore
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We need to recover scheduling goroutines for disttask framework's stability.

review_comments: even if we prevent the whole runtime exiting by recover, the `fetchAndHandleRunnableTasks` is dead and no tasks will be further proceed, what should we do in this situation?

> even if we prevent the whole runtime exiting by recover, the `fetchAndHandleRunnableTasks` is dead and no tasks will be further proceed, what should we do in this situation?

Nice catch, I will add more tests for `event loop canceled`, `panic after lock` cases.
